title: Line chart, filmed
description: Numbers over time as a shot: the camera starts close on the first point and pulls back while a glowing head draws the line, the value riding on the head counts up, a soft gold area fills behind it and the labels arrive as it passes. The value parks on the highest point and a thin light keeps travelling along the line.
